title: Dr. Sajid Sohail: High-Volume Clinic Operations & Patient Consultation Portal
formulaSummary: A responsive patient booking and clinical consultation workflow system built with React 19, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL for Dr. Sajid Sohail at Rahmania Medical Center, achieving a <5% patient no-show rate, saving 4 minutes per consultation intake, and increasing monthly consultations by 35%.

problem.heading: Hospital Quota Coordination & Manual Intake Bottlenecks
problem.description: Operating within Rahmania Medical Center, Dr. Sajid Sohail required a specialized digital workflow that coordinated seamlessly between hospital reception, patient inquiries, and daily consultation quotas. Relying on paper charts and phone calls led to scheduling gaps, manual errors in patient record intake, and high no-show rates during bad weather or hospital emergencies.
painPoints: Manual paper intake taking 4 to 5 minutes of doctor consultation time per patient
Scheduling gaps and no-show rates reaching 15% due to lack of automated reminders
Lack of coordination between central hospital reception desk and doctor examination room
Difficulty rapidly retrieving previous prescription and consultation history

solution.heading: Dynamic 15-Minute Slot Allocation & Pre-Consultation Questionnaires
solution.description: We built a tailored medical portal with 15-minute slot allocation, intelligent patient symptom intake questionnaires, and automated clinic confirmation notifications. The system features a doctor control panel to view expected patient volumes, mark completed consultations, and seamlessly reschedule appointments with one click. Hospital staff access a dedicated receptionist view to manage check-ins instantly.
keyDeliverables: 15-minute slot allocation algorithm tailored to daily hospital consultation quotas
Pre-filled digital symptom intake questionnaires submitted prior to patient arrival
Doctor control console with 1-click consultation completion and history lookup
Dedicated receptionist view for check-ins, queue management, and quota pacing

architecture.overview: Lightweight, sub-second web architecture connecting patient booking with the doctor's consultation desk and hospital reception. Intake data is cached and synchronized in real time.
